chars.O: OUSSAMA: a 23-year-old Moroccan delivery rider wearing a bright yellow delivery jacket with a dark green collar, black jeans, white sneakers, a big square yellow delivery backpack without any logo.
chars.R: RANIA: a wealthy elegant Moroccan woman in her thirties wearing a long emerald green silk kaftan-style dress with gold trim, gold bracelets, a small gold necklace.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a luxurious Moroccan villa entrance hall with zellige tiles and arches, Casablanca. RANIA holds out a set of golden house keys to OUSSAMA, standing close and looking at him intently; OUSSAMA, surprised and hesitant, reaches for the keys. Charged tense moment between them.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: At the open front gate of a white villa with palm trees in the evening, RANIA smiles and gestures inviting him to come anytime, OUSSAMA holds the keys in his hand looking at them with a nervous smile.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: At night on a quiet Casablanca residential street, OUSSAMA rides a small red scooter with the yellow delivery box on the back, heading toward a lit white villa in the distance.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Late at night outside a small Moroccan cafe and shops, OUSSAMA, tired, takes off his helmet next to his parked scooter, finishing his work shift, streetlights glowing.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: OUSSAMA sitting on his parked scooter at night, holding his phone down, smiling mischievously as he gets an idea for a surprise, a lightbulb-like warm glow on his face from a shop window.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Daydream scene: in a cozy villa living room, OUSSAMA and RANIA sit on a sofa happily watching a movie together, a bowl of snacks, warm lamp light.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small Moroccan supermarket at night, OUSSAMA happily picks an expensive gold box of chocolates from a shelf, holding it up proudly.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: At night, OUSSAMA quietly opens the big wooden front door of the dark villa with the golden key, holding the box of chocolates, tiptoeing in with a sneaky smile, dim hallway.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Inside the dark villa, OUSSAMA frozen halfway up a marble staircase, the box of chocolates in his hand, staring in shock at a closed bedroom door at the top where warm light leaks out from under it, his eyes wide.
